entities.summary: Michele di Pietro was an Papalini Catholic prelate who served as Major Penitentiary of the Apostolic Penitentiary and as Prefect of the Congregation of Propaganda Fide. He was elevated to the cardinalate in 1801. He was an uncle of Cardinal Camillo di Pietro.
